svg.title: Bagpipe chanter, a tapering 6-sided bore of finger-jointed strips, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Bagpipe chanter, a tapering 6-sided bore of finger-jointed strips, sheet 1 of 1. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Orange #ff8000 cuts the bores, seats, finger and pin holes first; then black #000000 frees the plates.
